purpose: Pattern recording matrices through clips, masks, opacity, instances, text, affine maps and nested boundaries. Authored viewBox scaling and external image scaling are independent actuals; their pixels may differ.

recipes.authoredViewport: Capture the intrinsic-size SVG image with capture-chrome-process.ps1, three fresh processes per actual.
recipes.externalScale: Restore the root to width=32, height=32 with no viewBox, then decode one SVG Blob image and drawImage to the recorded output dimensions in a fresh healthy ChromeProcess. Three fresh processes per actual.
recipes.suppliedFont: Replace font-family=serif with ReviewFont and insert a style immediately after the root opening tag: @font-face{font-family:ReviewFont;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,FONT_BYTES)}. The capture source SHA-256 includes this exact serialization.

linuxFontCapture.purpose: Separate native supplied-font metrics for Linux; every authored/external source captured in three fresh healthy processes.
